state.goal: Check whether the existing paired Torah/Haftarah Etnachta notation supplies an independently identified second landmark for a uniform-transposition pitch test.
observed: Original paired render visually inspected. Both panels are identical four-row diagrams of named accent boxes and signs: Mercha Tipcha Munach Etnachta; Tipcha Munach Etnachta; Mercha Tipcha Etnachta; Tipcha Etnachta, read right-to-left.
The diagram has no musical staff, numeric pitch, note-frequency assignment, audio timestamp or syllable-to-time alignment. The two PDF URLs have the same recorded SHA256.
Tipcha occurs exactly once in every row; row4 has only Tipcha then Etnachta. This supplies a structural landmark identity chosen without fitting acoustic values, but not its timed acoustic interval.

Existing audio records are contemporary teaching performances. The terminal periodicity estimates are 175.82 and188.24Hz, with octave/endpoint alignment uncertainty. The four-group RMS segmentation is expressly candidate-only and unstable in the Haftarah recording across thresholds.

Existing transposition test states one positive paired anchor always fits one positive scale factor. An independent second pair and uncertainty/octave checks are still required to evaluate that model.
constraints: Use actual sources; sheet identity, audio-event correspondence and an acoustic estimate are different evidence levels.

Do not select a second peak because it yields a desired cents residual, treat duplicate PDFs as independent witnesses, or call a new performer/tradition independent merely because there are four teaching rows.
Do not infer ancient intended pronunciation or one fixed note per accent from modern teaching material.
This unit may write source-grounded evidence, not edit existing endpoint/segmentation results or invent an alignment.

bounded_next_action.instructions: Select the useful next action for this source audit. This selects research work, not whether a historical or acoustic proposition is mathematically true.

criteria.document_candidate_and_exact_alignment_o: Document Tipcha row4 as the independently named structural candidate, explicitly withhold a measured second-anchor claim, preserve duplicate-source and segmentation limitations, and specify blinded label-to-audio alignment and pitch-window/uncertainty controls for the next experiment.
criteria.expand_to_full_syllable_alignment_now: Extend this bounded review into fresh independent audio listening/transcription of all four rows in both recordings before writing the landmark evidence. Keep pitch values hidden until the labels and intervals are fixed.
criteria.seek_a_timed_or_staff_notated_edition_fi: Seek a different primary teaching edition supplying timed syllable landmarks or staff transcription, keep the current source comparison conditional, and transfer to these two recordings only after validating the edition's same-phrase correspondence.
